packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: AirportCDMPartner
classes.definition: An abstract party that takes part in the Airport CDM process and is informed of, or provides, milestone information.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name identifying the partner.

classes.name: TurnRoundPartner
classes.definition: The Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler (AO/GH), referred to jointly by the document, who together manage the turn-round and provide TOBT and related operational times.

operations.name: updateTOBT
operations.description: TOBT is updated automatically or inserted manually, calculated on the basis of the defined/estimated turn-round period for the departing flight (M3,6,7,8); manual input overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (M2,3).

operations.name: confirmFinalTOBT
operations.description: AO/GH provide their most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation, t minutes before EOBT, a locally agreed parameter (M9).

operations.name: reportGroundHandlingStart
operations.description: Provides ACGT, the actual commencement of ground handling operations, for flights that are the first operation of the day or long-term parked (M8).

operations.name: reportAircraftReady
operations.description: Provides ARDT: all doors closed, boarding bridge removed, push back vehicle connected, ready to taxi immediately upon reception of TWR instructions (M12).

operations.name: manageTurnRound
operations.description: In coordination with the aircrew, manages the turn-round process accordingly following TOBT confirmation and TSAT issue (M9,10).

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline operating the flight, responsible for submitting the ATC Flight Plan and, jointly with the Ground Handler, providing TOBT and turn-round data.

operations.name: submitAtcFlightPlan
operations.description: Submits the ICAO ATC Flight Plan, which is distributed by IFPS so all involved ATC units, including departure and destination aerodromes, receive it (M1).

operations.name: provideCorrectInformation
operations.description: Must provide correct information before the first E-DPI message, feeding Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data as early in time as possible (M1).

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The ground handling company that carries out turn-round operations for the flight.

classes.name: ATCUnit
classes.definition: An air traffic control unit (ACC, Approach Control, Tower, or ATS unit) that receives the flight plan, detects the flight, calculates EXOT, and issues TSAT/ASAT.

attributes.name: unitRole
attributes.description: The role of the ATC unit, e.g. Area Control Centre (ACC), Approach Control Unit, or Tower (M4,5,16).

operations.name: calculateEXOT
operations.description: The ATC system calculates and provides the Estimated Taxi-Out Time based on the predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position, following receipt of TOBT (M9).

operations.name: issueTSAT
operations.description: ATC issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time, t minutes before EOBT, a locally agreed parameter (M10).

operations.name: approveStartUp
operations.description: ATC gives start-up approval (ASAT) following a pilot's request, on receipt of which the aircraft will start up, push back and taxi (M14).

operations.name: confirmTSATToPilot
operations.description: ATC confirms TSAT to the pilot to maintain the aircraft in the pre-departure sequence and assure that a regulated flight can respect its CTOT (M13).

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: Detects the flight based upon its assigned SSR code, when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary (M4) or a defined range/position/level on final approach (M5).

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, monitors flight progress via ETFMS, and is kept informed by DPI messages so ATC Flight Plan estimates stay consistent.

operations.name: issueCTOT
operations.description: Issues the CTOT, sent to relevant ATS units and the departure aerodrome, for regulated flights at EOBT-2h (M2).

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: Monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS and sends a Flight Update Message providing updates of the flight's progress, when within 3 hrs flying time of the destination (M3).

operations.name: receiveDPI
operations.description: Receives DPI messages informing it of updated take-off time estimates (M1,2,3,10,15).

classes.name: StandGateManagement
classes.definition: The party managing stand and gate allocation, which shares EOBT with ATC and Network Operations and is affected by stand/gate change decisions.

classes.name: Aircrew
classes.definition: The flight crew (pilot) who requests start-up and coordinates with the Ground Handler during the turn-round.

operations.name: requestStartUp
operations.description: The pilot requests start-up just before TSAT, following coordination with the Ground Handler, producing the Actual Start-up Request Time (M12,13).

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single arrival or departure flight tracked through the CDM process from ATC Flight Plan activation to take-off, carrying its operational status and successive time estimates.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether the flight is an arrival or a departure; one turn-round normally includes an arriving and a departing flight (M1).

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Type of aircraft, which the flight plan may be used to update (M1).

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration, fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI (M1).

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight, changed at each milestone (M1-16).

attributes.name: isRegulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and has received a CTOT; regulated flights usually have priority and have fields marked REGULATED (M2).

attributes.name: offBlockTime
attributes.description: Latest off-block time value (SOBT/EOBT/TOBT/AOBT); every successive value is kept (M1-15).

attributes.name: inBlockTime
attributes.description: Latest in-block time value (EIBT/AIBT) (M1,3-7).

attributes.name: landingTime
attributes.description: Latest landing time value (ELDT/ALDT) (M1-6).

attributes.name: takeOffTime
attributes.description: Latest take-off time value (ETOT/TTOT/CTOT/ATOT) (M1-10,15,16).

attributes.name: taxiOutTime
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) (M2,3,9,15).

attributes.name: taxiInTime
attributes.description: Estimated taxi-in time (EXIT) (M4,6).

attributes.name: startUpApprovalTime
attributes.description: Target/Actual start-up approval time (TSAT/ASAT) (M9,10,12-14).

attributes.name: boardingTime
attributes.description: Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) (M11).

attributes.name: readyTime
attributes.description: Actual Ready Time (ARDT) (M12,13).

attributes.name: startUpRequestTime
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Request Time (ASRT) (M13,14).

operations.name: isReadyWithin15MinOfEOBT
operations.description: The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT (M1).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round, normally comprising an arriving flight and a related departing flight, analysed using the minimum turn-round time.

attributes.name: minimumTurnRoundTime
attributes.description: MTTT, the minimum/estimated turn-round period used to calculate TOBT and TTOT for the departing flight (M2,3,6,7,8).

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, identified by type and registration.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration (M1).

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Type of aircraft (M1).

classes.name: AtcFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan submitted to ATC for a flight, distributed by IFPS, which may be a one-off submission or a repetitive flight plan (RFPL).

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether this is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (M1).

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: Scheduled Off-Block Time carried on the flight plan, fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI (M1).

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: Destination aerodrome named on the flight plan (M1).

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: Departure aerodrome named on the flight plan (M1).

attributes.name: submissionTime
attributes.description: Time the flight plan is submitted, normally 3 hours before EOBT, though it may be later (M1).

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent (M1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot allocated to the flight under the airport slot programme, with which the ATC Flight Plan must correspond.

attributes.name: slotTime
attributes.description: The scheduled slot time under the airport slot programme (M1).

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A time quantity describing a flight's progress, named by a prefix (Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, Calculated) and an event, with its origin, accuracy and tolerance; every successive value is kept.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether the value is Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual or Calculated.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The time value itself.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy of the value, e.g. +/- 1 minute (M3,6,7,8,11,12,13,14,15,16).

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The tolerance agreed, locally or otherwise, before a change is reported, e.g. the TTOT tolerance or TSAT tolerance window (M3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12,13,14,15).

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: Who provided or updated this value, e.g. AO/GH, ATC, ACARS, Network Operations.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded, so the turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

operations.name: recordValue
operations.description: Appends a new successive value with its originator and time of update rather than overwriting the previous value.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: The off-block time for the flight, held as SOBT, EOBT, TOBT or AOBT depending on its prefix.

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: The in-block time for the flight, held as EIBT or AIBT depending on its prefix.

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: EIBT is computed using the ELDT/ALDT and the estimated/actual taxi-in time EXIT (M4,6).

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: The landing time for the flight, held as ELDT or ALDT depending on its prefix.

operations.name: calculateELDT
operations.description: ELDT is calculated using the ATOT and the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL (M3).

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: The take-off time for the flight, held as ETOT, TTOT, CTOT or ATOT depending on its prefix.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculation basis for TTOT is EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT (M2); if EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT (M3); if TOBT is available it overrules the EIBT+MTTT estimate, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (M2,3).

classes.name: TaxiOutTime
classes.definition: The Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT), calculated by the ATC system.

classes.name: TaxiInTime
classes.definition: The estimated taxi-in time (EXIT), used with ELDT/ALDT to compute EIBT.

classes.name: MinimumTurnRoundTime
classes.definition: The minimum/estimated turn-round period (MTTT) used as the basis for calculating TOBT and TTOT for a departing flight.

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: The start-up approval time for the flight, held as TSAT or ASAT depending on its prefix.

classes.name: BoardingTime
classes.definition: The Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT), when the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding.

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The Actual Ready Time (ARDT), when the aircraft's doors are closed, boarding bridge removed, and push-back vehicle connected.

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The Actual Start-Up Request Time (ASRT), when start-up is requested by the pilot.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: One of the sixteen defined events of the Airport CDM process, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect on operational status, and procedure.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the milestone.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: What triggers this milestone process, as stated by the document.

attributes.name: timingRule
attributes.description: The timing rule stated for when this milestone normally occurs.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: The effect the milestone has on estimates and decisions, as stated by the document.

attributes.name: operationalStatusChange
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to at this milestone.

classes.name: M1FlightPlanActivated
classes.definition: The milestone at which the ICAO flight plan is submitted to ATC and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent, to confirm the flight to Network Operations and allow further local processing (M1).

operations.name: sendFirstEDPI
operations.description: Sends the first E-DPI message once correct SOBT, registration and first destination data are provided; should not be sent if information is missing or inconsistent; triggered by first activation of the flight plan (earliest EOBT-3hr) or new/late submissions after cancellation or revised EOBT (M1).

operations.name: updateArrivalEstimates
operations.description: For an arrival, ELDT and EIBT are updated (M1).

operations.name: updateDepartureEstimates
operations.description: For a departure, EOBT and ETOT are updated (M1).

operations.name: initiateOutboundFlight
operations.description: For non-coordinated airports the flight plan is used to initiate the outbound flight; for coordinated airports the outbound flight is already known (M1).

classes.name: M2EOBTMinus2h
classes.definition: The milestone at EOBT-2h at which most flights are known, regulated flights receive a CTOT, and Network Operations is informed of the updated take-off time estimate.

operations.name: checkFlightEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks, before or after take-off from outstation, whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, verifying feasibility of EOBT at EOBT-2hrs (M2).

operations.name: sendFirstTDPI
operations.description: Informs Network Operations of the updated take-off time estimate via a first T-DPI message at EOBT-2hrs (M2).

operations.name: markRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED for a flight that has received a CTOT (M2).

operations.name: updateInboundELDT
operations.description: For inbound flights, ELDT is updated based on information provided by FUM messages, taking into account the actual progress of the flight (M2).

classes.name: M3TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: The milestone at which the ATOT from the outstation is recorded and used to check and update downstream estimates.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH estimated landing time after take-off from outstation is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan (M3).

operations.name: sendTDPIt
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about updated take-off time estimates using a T-DPI-t message when needed, respecting a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes before informing (M3).

operations.name: receiveOutstationATOT
operations.description: Records ATOT, received from either the Network Operations FUM or via the AO/GH, if the destination is more than 3 hrs flying time away (M3).

classes.name: M4LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: The milestone at which the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport, detected by radar via the assigned SSR code.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, given the updated ELDT (M4).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (M4).

operations.name: preventStandGateChangeAfterELDTMinus30
operations.description: Any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30', taking into account the taxi-in time EXIT, to decrease last-minute stand/gate changes (M4).

classes.name: M5FinalApproach
classes.definition: The milestone at which the flight enters the Final Approach phase, detected by radar crossing a defined range/position or level.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, given the updated ELDT (M5).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (M5).

classes.name: M6Landed
classes.definition: The milestone at which ALDT, the actual landing time, is recorded.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan (M6).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (M6).

operations.name: updateELDTtoALDT
operations.description: ELDT changes to ALDT on landing, triggering an update of downstream estimates TOBT and TTOT, and EIBT may be updated as ALDT+EXIT (M6).

classes.name: M7InBlock
classes.definition: The milestone at which AIBT, the actual in-block time, is recorded.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan (M7).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (M7).

operations.name: updateEIBTtoAIBT
operations.description: EIBT changes to AIBT, triggering an update of downstream estimates TOBT and TTOT, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight (M7).

classes.name: M8GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: The milestone at which ground handling operations commence (ACGT), specific to flights that are the first operation of the day or have been long-term parked.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan (M8).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (M8).

classes.name: M9FinalConfirmationTOBT
classes.definition: The milestone at which the AO/GH provides its most accurate TOBT, t minutes before EOBT, prior to TSAT issue.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: At a predefined local time, checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue (M9).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (M9).

operations.name: confirmTOBT
operations.description: Triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update; no need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has already been manually modified before (M9).

classes.name: M10TSATIssued
classes.definition: The milestone at which ATC issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time (TSAT), t minutes before EOBT.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTSAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight; Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights (M10).

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued exceeds a locally defined tolerance; if exceeded the TOBT input is processed according to local procedure (M10).

classes.name: M11BoardingStarts
classes.definition: The milestone at which the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding (ASBT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfASBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time when it occurs (M11).

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a locally defined time before TOBT (e.g. corresponding to aircraft type), checks the boarding status and informs the AO/GH if TOBT needs updating (M11).

classes.name: M12AircraftReady
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back (ARDT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfARDT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ARDT or Ready Status (RDY) in the Airport CDM Platform, confirming that the flight follows the indicated TOBT (M12).

operations.name: alertIfNoReadyStatus
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance, informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed and no ready status message has yet been received (M12).

classes.name: M13StartUpRequested
classes.definition: The milestone at which start-up is requested (ASRT), based on the pilot's request to ATC.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASRT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start-up Request Time when it occurs (M13).

operations.name: alertIfNoStartUpRequest
operations.description: If the start-up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, informs the AO/GH that no start-up has been requested and that TOBT should be updated (M13).

classes.name: M14StartUpApproved
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft receives its start-up approval (ASAT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfASAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASAT in the Airport CDM Platform, confirming that the aircraft has received start-up approval/push-back clearance (M14).

operations.name: checkASATAgainstTSAT
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT; if start-up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced (M14).

classes.name: M15OffBlock
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position (AOBT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfAOBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of AOBT in the Airport CDM Platform, that the aircraft has commenced push-back/taxi from the parking position (M15).

operations.name: sendADPI
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or in the case of remote holding, at a defined time prior to TTOT (M15).

operations.name: checkTTOTChangeAndInform
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT (M15).

classes.name: M16TakeOff
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft takes off from the runway (ATOT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfATOT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take-off (M16).

operations.name: generateAirborneMessageAndRemoveFromSequence
operations.description: Generates an airborne message and removes the flight from the departure sequence, triggered by Tower FDPS, A-SMGCS/Radar detection or ACARS (M16).

operations.name: sendFSAandMVT
operations.description: Sends FSA and MVT messages (M16).

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform, the technical system initiated for each flight that processes available information, computes estimates, and records the Actions on CDM Operation (ACISP) at each milestone.

attributes.name: initiatedFlight
attributes.description: The flight for which the platform has been initiated (M1).

operations.name: initiateForFlight
operations.description: The Airport CDM Platform is initiated for this flight and all available information is processed (M1).

operations.name: computeTOBTAutomatically
operations.description: TOBT is calculated automatically by the Airport CDM Platform, following an ELDT update (M4).

operations.name: recordAOBT
operations.description: Records AOBT (M15).

operations.name: recordATOT
operations.description: Records ATOT (M16).

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The system that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: Distributes the ATC Flight Plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator so that all involved ATC units, including departure and destination aerodromes, receive it (M1).

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: The system Network Operations uses to monitor progress of a flight within 3 hrs flying time of the destination airport.

operations.name: monitorProgress
operations.description: Monitors progress of the flight so that Network Operations can send a Flight Update Message providing updates of the flight's progress (M3).

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The aircraft system that can automatically report actual times equivalent to ALDT, AIBT, AOBT and ATOT.

operations.name: reportEvent
operations.description: Reports an actual time (ACARS=ON at landing M6, IN at in-block M7, OUT at off-block M15, OFF at take-off M16), with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: AirportSurveillanceSystem
classes.definition: The radar, A-SMGCS or Tower FDPS system that detects a flight by its assigned SSR code crossing the FIR/ATC boundary, entering final approach, or taking off.

operations.name: detectFIRCrossing
operations.description: Detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary (M4).

operations.name: detectFinalApproach
operations.description: Detects when the flight crosses a defined range/position or passes/leaves a predetermined level on final approach (M5).

operations.name: detectTakeOff
operations.description: Detects take-off via Tower FDPS, A-SMGCS or Radar (M16).

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s or A-DPI) sent to Network Operations to inform of updated take-off time estimates.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of DPI message sent, as named by the document (E-DPI M1, T-DPI M2, T-DPI-t M3, T-DPI-s M10, A-DPI M15).

attributes.name: sentAt
attributes.description: The time the message was sent.

operations.name: send
operations.description: Sends the message to Network Operations.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The FUM sent by Network Operations, via ETFMS, that provides updates of a flight's progress and is used to update ELDT.

attributes.name: progressData
attributes.description: The progress data the FUM provides (M2,3).

classes.name: FSAMessage
classes.definition: The FSA message sent when the aircraft takes off.

classes.name: MVTMessage
classes.definition: The MVT message sent when the aircraft takes off.

classes.name: AirborneMessage
classes.definition: The airborne message generated when the aircraft takes off, after which the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: The Ready Status (RDY) message that may be sent instead of ARDT, confirming the flight follows the indicated TOBT.
